notes: Q1 — Does a Chinese Alien RPG / Foundry translation exist? PARTIALLY, and it is already on disk. The alienrpg system ships lang/cn.json (511 keys) and lang/zh-tw.json. The local 4.1.13 copy is BYTE-IDENTICAL to upstream master (verified by curl + dict compare), so there is nothing newer to pull. No Chinese translation of the RULEBOOK exists — no fan PDF, no 网盘 release, no 汉化组 project surfaced in any search. Search noise is dominated by the video game 异形：隔离 (Alien: Isolation), which has several unrelated Chinese patches.

Q1 provenance — Who wrote cn.json: GitHub user TI-130 (Tyronemonitor@gmail.com), credited by the maintainer as Discord handle Tian#7972. Three direct commits: 39cf7378 (2020-11-13 'Add Lang support: Chinese'), ee3f0c92 (2020-11-13 fix), 8ffd21ba (2020-12-02 update), 13d3a6bd (2021-01-19 update); the maintainer's bef3d346 and 7aa602c9 credit 'Tian#7972' in the commit message. TI-130 stopped in Jan 2021 and has not touched it since.

Q1 quality — cn.json has TWO STRATA and they must be treated differently. STRATUM A (TI-130, 2020-11..2021-01, human, good): attributes, skills, careers, ranges, the whole d6+Stress Panic table (Panic7-Panic15, cn.json lines 293-301), SynthDontNeed, DefMacroHint. Idiomatic, consistent, uses 检定 for rolls. STRATUM B (2022-2026, maintainer bulk 'Updated all language files' passes, machine-translated, bad): every ALIENRPG.TAH.* tooltip, the whole spacecraft/colony/planet vocabulary, and the newer settings keys. Stratum B renders 'roll' as 滚动/翻滚/掷骰 at random, 'Shift' four different ways, 'Broken' three ways, 'Death Roll' four ways.

Q1 hard errors to fix on sight (all in stratum B): cn.json:186 GMONLY 'GM Only' -> 仅限通用汽车 (GM expanded to General Motors); cn.json:290 Overwatch -> 守望先锋 (the Blizzard game); cn.json:205 HOWMANYDICE 'How Many Base Die?' -> 有多少基地死亡？ ; cn.json:370 SelectFirer 'Select Firer' -> 选择消防员 (firefighter); ALIENRPG.None -> 莫 ; ALIENRPG.Ones: -> 那些: ; ALIENRPG.Homebrew -> 家酿 ; ALIENRPG.Utility -> 公用事业 ; ALIENRPG.OneTurn -> 一斡 ; ALIENRPG.NoSynCrit 'Synthetics table' -> 综合表 ; ALIENRPG.RollManShipMinorCrit says 'between 1 and 66' in EN but 介于 1 和 44 之间 in CN (numeric mismatch, also a data bug); ALIENRPG.Seepage106 EN says 'page 105' but CN says 第106面 (upstream issue #137 flagged this in 2021 and it is still wrong).

Q1 coverage gaps: 93 en.json keys are ABSENT from cn.json and 140 more are present-but-still-English. The entire Alien Evolved Edition (2025) vocabulary is untranslated: Resolve, Resolve Modifier, Stress Responses, Panic Responses, and the 20 condition words (jumpy, twitchy, spooked, paranoid, frantic, hesitant, noisy, shakes, tunnelvision, deflated, aggravated, fatigued, catatonic, frenzy, freeze, flee, scream, seekcover, loseitem, keepingguard), plus all cover/target-size modifiers, all SheetLabels, and all ShipPanic7-15 entries.

Q1 zh-tw.json is NOT an independent source. 342 of 511 strings are byte-identical to cn.json and the remaining 169 differ only by simplified->traditional character conversion. Only 12 pairs differ by length, and 10 of those are whitespace noise; the two real ones are ALIENRPG.cinematic (CN 电影 vs TW the Latin string 'CINEMA') and ALIENRPG.CrewGunner (TW has a stray leading space). Treat zh-tw as a mechanical s2t conversion of cn — do not mine it for alternative terminology.

Q2 — Chinese YZE glossary: DOES NOT EXIST. I found no Chinese fan translation or glossary for Mutant: Year Zero, Forbidden Lands, Coriolis, Vaesen, Tales from the Loop, Twilight: 2000, Blade Runner RPG or Dragonbane. Nothing on 純美蘋果園's TRPG译文专区 index, nothing on bilibili, nothing on GitHub. The ONLY Chinese YZE material I located anywhere is (a) this cn.json, and (b) one login-gated 純美蘋果園 thread 【翻译】异形RPG潜行规则（和其它）(topic=121082.0, ~2021-10-22) which translates the Alien RPG stealth rules. Conclusion: cn.json's stratum A is effectively the de-facto Chinese YZE glossary, and whatever you settle on here will become the reference for anyone who follows.

Q2 — the terminology decisions cn.json leaves genuinely open (real conflicts inside the file, not just MT noise): (1) Panic Roll = 恐慌检定 or 混乱检定 — UI keys say 恐慌, the human panic prose says 混乱; (2) Engaged = 近战 (UI key, but that collides with Melee) or 接战 (panic prose) — 接战 is the better choice; (3) Stress Level = 压力水平 or 压力等级; (4) Health = 生命 / 健康 / 生命值; (5) Synthetic = 生化人 (cn.json) or 仿生人 (all the Chinese film articles). Pick one of each up front.

Q3 — Franchise names: no Chinese Alien wiki exists. There is NO Chinese-language Alien/Xenopedia fandom wiki and no 灰机wiki (huijiwiki) Alien project. The only usable reference works are zh.wikipedia (异形系列 / 异形(电影) / 异形2 / 异形：夺命舰 / 韦兰-尤坦尼集团 / 异形(虚构生物)), 百度百科 (抱脸虫), and 萌娘百科 (M41A脉冲步枪, 抱脸虫 — both 403 to automated fetch).

Q3 — the ONE well-documented mainland/TW/HK split I could verify is the Alien: Romulus title: 大陆 异形：夺命舰 / 台湾 异形：罗穆路斯 / 香港 异形：罗穆卢斯. Also 异形2 (大陆·台湾) vs 异形续集 (香港). For the creature and hardware nouns, zh.wikipedia's variant machinery mostly just does simplified/traditional character conversion, so there is no separate 台湾/香港 terminology to record — 抱脸体/抱臉體, 破胸体/破胸體 are the same words in different scripts.

Q3 — the real fault line is not region but register: reference works say 抱脸体 / 破胸体, while mainland fan and 百度百科 usage says 抱脸虫 / 破胸者. Same for the company: zh.wikipedia says 韦兰-尤坦尼(集团) but the fan corpus (bilibili, douban, 机核) overwhelmingly says 维兰德-汤谷公司 / 维汤. Decide whether the glossary targets wiki-formal or player-colloquial register, because you cannot satisfy both.

Q3 — terms in the brief I could NOT source and that should be marked unresolved: 阿克伦 (Acheron), 哈德利希望镇 (Hadley's Hope — zh-wiki only offers the loose paraphrase 希望之地), 智能枪 (Smartgun), 动作追踪器 (Motion Tracker), 大气处理厂 (Atmosphere Processor — zh-wiki 异形2 calls it 核融合发电厂, which is a plot-summary error), and 苏拉科号 (Sulaco — zh-wiki says 苏拉克号). Do not treat any of these as settled. 韦兰-尤坦尼公司 should be 集团 not 公司 per zh-wiki. 诺斯托罗莫号 is fan usage; zh-wiki's own articles say 诺史莫号.

Q4 — Free League Chinese licence: NONE EXISTS. Free League's own press release lists exactly seven licensed Alien RPG editions with named partners: French/Arkhane Asylum, German/Ulisses Spiele, Spanish/Edge Entertainment, Italian/Wyrd Edizioni, Russian/Studio 101, Polish/Galakta, Portuguese/New Order Editora. No Chinese. freeleaguepublishing.com/games/alien/ mentions only English and Swedish. Free League's third-party/OGL programme (Dragonbane, Forbidden Lands, Symbaroum, Coriolis) enumerates ~13 permitted languages and Chinese is not among them — and Alien is not in that programme at all, since it is a 20th Century Studios licence. Practical consequence: any Chinese Alien RPG work is unlicensed fan translation, with a film-studio IP holder behind it. Keep it as a Babele/lang overlay, not a redistribution of book text.

Q5 — Foundry-specific: NO alienrpg Babele module exists. GitHub code search for a Babele mapping targeting alienrpg returns zero results; the only alienrpg modules on GitHub are BenTheCloudGuy/foundryvtt-alienrpg-module (MU/TH/UR terminal, no i18n) and Frenchy-s-module/alien-roll-request. Babele 2.9.1 is installed locally at <data>/modules/babele and does have built-in Adventure defaultMappings, which matters because all three Alien content packs are single-Adventure-document packs.

Q5 — upstream is current and receptive. Latest release 4.1.13 (2026-06-27, master.zip, 2898 downloads) == the installed version, and lang/cn.json in master == the local file exactly. Paul Watson (pwatson100) has accepted translations from at least four outside contributors (TI-130 Chinese, Txus5012 Spanish, Stefano1975t Italian, Moradion German, plus Brazilian Portuguese from three contributors). Issue #282 shows the accepted workflow is literally 'just open a PR'; issue #241 shows he will also take a zipped lang file attached to an issue. So a cleaned-up cn.json is straightforwardly upstreamable.

Q5 — lang code: use `cn`, not `zh-CN` or `zh-Hans`. alienrpg/system.json declares {"lang":"cn","name":"中文"}, and 14 packages on this install use `cn` (foundry_chn, pf2_cn, 5e_chn, crucible-cn, dice-so-nice, quick-insert...) versus only 2 using `zh-cn`. A Babele module for alienrpg must register under `cn` to line up with the core UI translation.

Q5 — the three Alien content modules are all English-only and Babele-shaped: alien-evolved-corerules v1.0.2 (langs: en; pack alien-evolved-core-rules, type Adventure), alien-evolved-starterset v1.0.2 (langs: en; pack alien-evolved-starter-set, type Adventure), and the system's own pack alien-rpg-system (type Adventure). alien-mu-th-ur v2.0.0 ships 9 languages but no Chinese; motion_tracker v1.5.5 has en/es/fr; token-action-hud-alien v1.3.0 and terminal v4.0.11 are en-only / have no language files at all. All are candidates for the same Chinese overlay.
